notes: HERO9 Black support is seeded from official GoPro support/manual behavior. The two sampled HERO9 cards were labeled U3000PRO/U3000PRO 1 from previous use, proving volume label should not be used as model proof. MISC/version.txt gave explicit HERO9 Black model and firmware evidence, but also contained private serial/Wi-Fi identifiers. GoPro media can span DCIM/100GOPRO, DCIM/101GOPRO, and later numbered GOPRO folders; scan every matching numbered media folder. Filename alone is not enough to distinguish normal video from time-lapse video because GoPro reuses the same GH/GX MP4 naming family.
